feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass finished beef for Atlanta and North Georgia from the Georgia Beef Company comes from cattle raised on grass pastures only, as the name implies.

resold_note: Pork is sourced from nearby farms.
notes: Buyer pays a deposit on a live animal and picks up from the processor; site names no whole, half or quarter sizes on pages read, so bulk_shares is false. About page says the family owns the Bridges Angus Farm herd and the company markets cattle born and raised in Georgia; site refers to our cattle but does not state outright the company raises them. Grass-finished page also shows a 100% High Quality Grains badge, conflicting with its grass pastures wording. Separate grain-finished line uses corn and oats as a supplement.
